# The files and directories that make up the shipped extension — the single
# source for "does this change need a version bump and a release?".
#
# Read by ci.yml's release-readiness job and release.yml's gate. The three
# shipping workflows (pack.yml, sign-firefox.yml, publish-chrome.yml) still
# carry their own zip/copy lists, because a shell list is not a regex —
# test/ship-list.test.js fails if any of them drifts from this file.
#
# A trailing slash marks a directory (shipped whole). docs/ is NOT here: the
# site deploys from Pages on every merge and is not part of the add-on.
manifest.json
sw.js
rules.js
share.js
standard-headers.js
popup.html
popup.css
popup/
icons/
